metadata.name: [JJBA+] Framework
metadata.description:
[JJBA+] core framework. Required by all [JJBA+] character mods.
Why a framework? I want to go next level with this tboi JJBA mods, so this framework will help creating new characters and adding new (future) mechanics like: - Stand Disc: An item for every stand. - Stand Disc Room: A room like planetary where any character can grab a stand disc from any of the installed JJBA+ character mods, gaining an stand or switching with one already equiped. - Stand Arrow: An item that gives the player a random stand from their installed JJBA+ characters mod. If player already has a stand, then this item will evolve the stand to a Requiem form (with custom ones for characters that dont have a cannon one). - Broken Stand Arrow: Same as the above item, but as a trinket. - Many more...
Whats next? I will be polishing the framework at the same time i fix and polishing Jotaro and Kakyion characters, so i can have a good base for it. Once i feel the proyect base line its fine, i will share the github repo so anybody can use it (maybe you can already work with this mod a little, but i dont recomend doing so till the 1.0 release). My idea is to talk and ask permision to migrate other characters to JJBA+ framework or even allow other people to add their own ones to the repo, just to keep trac of them and keep compabilities.
Why now? I dunno, i just wanted. Anyways, this will be a side project i will be working on besides my job and studies, so dont be waiting for weekly updates or so.
Why JJBA+? Its just an easy name to distinguish from other JJBA mods.
Thanks to https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=943074431 creators, for being the base of this mod.
